Proficient welding with various rods including 6010 and 7018
Thorough knowledge of various metals, their characteristics and qualities, correct welding processes, and the effects of welding on material
Able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings

cond_0027.responsibilities:
We work together to plan and carry out welding tasks across a range of equipment and materials. Responsibilities include:
Coordinate with the team to select equipment and plan layouts, assembly, and welding, applying shared knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Work alongside crew members to lay out, position, align, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and locations.
Secure parts in position for welding by bolting, clamping, and tack-welding in coordination with helpers and laborers.
Set up equipment and weld parts together using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Work with the team to weld metal materials to piping systems and equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Help identify all equipment needed for the job and process.
Support the team in identifying all safety risks and requirements.

Able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings to perform work efficiently
Able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable
4+ Years of industrial welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment
Ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions
Proficient welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 and 7018
Thorough knowledge of various metals, their characteristics and qualities, correct welding processes, and the effects of welding on the material
Must successfully pass a weld test
Experience welding multiple types of material including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum, and chrome
Able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding
Reliable transportation
Able to work at heights as required

Work alongside others to lay out, position, align, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places. Bolt, clamp, and tack-weld parts to secure in position for welding. Set up equipment and weld parts using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment. Work with the team to weld metal materials to piping systems and equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved. Help identify all equipment for the job and process. Support the team in identifying all safety risks and requirements.
cond_0144.requirements:
Must be able to Stick/Mig weld on varies types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions). SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead). Without a backing strip. Must successfully pass a weld test. Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience. Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities. Must be able to meet all physical requirements. Must have all the tools.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform efficiently work. Must be able to read and interrupt technical manuals as applicable. Must have 4+ years of experience welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment. Must have the ability to stick weld in 2g, 3g, and 4g conditions. Must be proficient in welding with varies rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018. Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristic and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material. Must successfully pass a weld test. Must have experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome. Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding. Must have reliable transportation. Must be able to work at heights as required. Must meet all physical demands (see section below).
This position does not have any direct reports; however the position will work closely with and oversee on occasion of helper and labor positions. The position will hold a positional and expertise authority of the helper and laborer positions.

Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.

cond_0153.intro: We are looking for a Structural Welder to join our team.
cond_0153.responsibilities:
We work together to plan and carry out welding tasks across a range of equipment and materials. Responsibilities include:
Coordinate with the team to select equipment and plan layouts, assembly, and welding, applying shared knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques.
Work alongside crew members to lay out, position, align, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and locations.
Secure parts in position for welding by bolting, clamping, and tack-welding in coordination with helpers and laborers.
Set up equipment and weld parts together using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment.
Work with the team to weld metal materials to piping systems and equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved.
Help identify all equipment needed for the job and process.
Support the team in identifying all safety risks and requirements.
cond_0153.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings to perform work efficiently
Able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable
4+ Years of industrial welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment
Ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions
Proficient welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 and 7018
Thorough knowledge of various metals, their characteristics and qualities, correct welding processes, and the effects of welding on the material
Must successfully pass a weld test
Experience welding multiple types of material including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum, and chrome
Able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding
Reliable transportation
Able to work at heights as required
Must meet all physical demands (see section below)

Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques. Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places. Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding. Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment. Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved. Identify all equipment for job and process. Identify all safety risks and requirements.
This position does not have any direct reports; however the position will work closely with and oversee on occasion helper and labor positions. The position will hold a positional and expertise authority of the helper and laborer positions.
cond_0429.requirements:
Must be able to Stick/MIG weld on various types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions). SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead). Without a backing strip. Must successfully pass a weld test. Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience. Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities. Must be able to meet all physical requirements. Must have all the tools.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform work efficiently. Must be able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable. Must have 4+ years of welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment. Must have the ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions. Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018. Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristics and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material. Must have experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome. Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding. Must have reliable transportation. Must be able to work at heights as required.
Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.
Required tool list: to be provided.

cond_0501.responsibilities:
Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques. Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places. Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding. Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment. Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved. Identify all equipment for job and process. Identify all safety risks and requirements.
This position does not have any direct reports; however the position will work closely with and oversee on occasion helper and labor positions. The position will hold a positional and expertise authority of the helper and laborer positions.

Must be able to Stick/MIG weld on various types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions). SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead). Without a backing strip. Must successfully pass a weld test. Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience. Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities. Must be able to meet all physical requirements. Must have all the tools.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform work efficiently. Must be able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable. Must have 4+ years of welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment. Must have the ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions. Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018. Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristics and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material. Must have experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome. Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding. Must have reliable transportation. Must be able to work at heights as required.

Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.

Selects equipment and plans layouts, assembly, and welding applying knowledge of geometry, physical properties of metal machining, weld shrinkage, and welding techniques. Layout, position, aligns, cut, assemble, and fit metal components together in various body positions and in various places. Bolts, clamps, and tack-welds parts to secure in position for welding. Sets up equipment and welds parts, using arc, gas-shielded arc, submerged arc, or gas arc welding equipment. Weld metal materials to piping systems equipment using the appropriate welding procedure for the various equipment and metal types involved. Identify all equipment for job and process. Identify all safety risks and requirements.
This position does not have any direct reports; however the position will work closely with and oversee on occasion helper and labor positions. The position will hold a positional and expertise authority of the helper and laborer positions.
cond_0627.requirements:
Must be able to Stick/MIG weld on various types of equipment and material, HBZ-130-2G, 3G, 4G tests (which is 3 tests and 3 positions). SMAW (7018-1), Carbon steel plate (.500"" thick) in the 2G (horizontal) 3G (Vertical) 4G (overhead). Without a backing strip. Must successfully pass a weld test. Must have 4+ years of industrial welding experience. Must have all required knowledge, skills, and abilities. Must be able to meet all physical requirements. Must have all the tools.
Must be able to read blueprints and other engineering drawings in order to perform work efficiently. Must be able to read and interpret technical manuals as applicable. Must have 4+ years of welding experience on industrial size and grade equipment. Must have the ability to stick weld in 2G, 3G, and 4G conditions. Must be proficient in welding with various rods including but not limited to 6010 & 7018. Must have a thorough knowledge of various metals characteristics and qualities including the correct welding processes required and the effects of welding on the material. Must have experience welding multiple types of material possibly including but not limited to: carbon steel, Fluxcore, stainless, aluminum and chrome. Must be able and willing to assist with other activities while not actively welding. Must have reliable transportation. Must be able to work at heights as required.
Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.
Required tool list: to be provided.

Employee will be required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, sitting and lifting. Will talk and hear to communicate. Will use arms and hands to signal, grab, hold, turn, push, and pull: objects, materials, controls and tools. May be required to pick up, lift, carry and move up to 50lbs. Will work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and may occasionally work off of platforms/scaffolding using the appropriate fall protection requirements. Must be able to work in all weather conditions (including heat, rain, cold and wind) while wearing appropriate PPE. Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to: hard hat, safety glasses/spoggles, ear plugs, masks/respirators, hi-vis safety vests, leather gloves and leather steel-toed work boots.
